body:
## What it does

It covers the working day of a social team end to end: queueing and sending posts out across more than a dozen networks, then gathering everything that comes back, from private messages to public reviews, into one place to be answered from. Live performance figures sit alongside the replies.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @eclincher shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
